content:
- Model tends to overestimate prices in early forecast windows, especially after recent spikes; apply downward bias correction for first 5–7 days.
- After a price spike, model often overshoots and fails to correct downward; reduce forecast slope after peak by 10–15%.
- When sentiment is neutral (all 0.00), model exhibits high volatility and overconfidence; dampen forecast variance and anchor to recent 7-day mean.
- True outcomes show strong mean reversion toward 70–75 range after 10+ days of high prices; model fails to reflect this; add 3–5 day moving average constraint.
- If true outcome dips below 70 after 10+ days of above 80, model should not reset to 80+; apply “floor” rule at 68–72 for 3–5 days.
- Forecast horizon 30d often overestimates late-term prices; reduce final 5–7 days by 5–8% to align with observed tapering.
